scope: Asset cards, catalog, enforcement and verification on existing stable native clip IDs; not the entire attachment one-week graphics roadmap.

inventory.budgetException: Pinned original Inter variable TTF: 879708 bytes, retained for glyph coverage and compatibility.

checks.cardApiContract: Requires a current card receipt before app-run agent insertion, duplicate/new split layer or direct patch. Existing property edits remain available without extra card context.

fullSmoke.comparison: Decoded frame/audio hashes; container metadata deliberately excluded

telemetry.estimator: Estimated request + tool argument/result bytes / 4; excludes agent base prompt/tool definitions. Actual provider usage is separate.

limits: Native implementations/previews are agent-authored and do not satisfy a strict human-made-only asset policy.
External human attribution records upstream evidence, not forensic proof of the creation process.
Publisher-supplied card/license/test claims are displayed as unverified, not promoted to independent ClipKit verification.
Orphan age is a card-file-age heuristic over declared scene references, not continuous live usage telemetry.
Frame and full-video proofs were executed on one local Linux/Chromium environment; no second-machine certification.
No new 3D, fluid/shader bake, Lottie or animation-engine dependency was adopted.
No new CC-BY graphic was bundled; an automatic CC-BY credits scene remains outside this update.
